@view.cancel.description: Button that closes a picker or dialog without choosing.

@view.done.description: Button that confirms a picker's choice.

@view.ok.description: Button that confirms an alert or dialog.

@view.previousMonth.description: Date picker button that shows the month before.

@view.nextMonth.description: Date picker button that shows the month after.

@view.hour.description: Time picker column of hours, read by screen readers.

@view.minute.description: Time picker column of minutes, read by screen readers.

@view.period.description: Time picker column choosing morning or afternoon on a 12-hour clock.

@view.options.description: Accessible name of a list of choices that has no label.

@view.dialog.description: Accessible name of a dialog that has no title.

@view.actions.description: Accessible name of an action sheet.
